ambiguities.source_text: Filter out any specimen that doesn't have a measurement for each trait
ambiguities.intent: The required traits are Total_body_length, Prosoma_length, Prosoma_width, Prosoma_height, Tibia_I_length and Fang_length.
Exclude the whole specimen if any required trait is nonnumeric or missing.
Exclude the whole specimen if any required trait contains an asterisk.

ambiguities.intent: Compute each trait minimum and maximum across eligible species means, after removing invalid specimens and retaining species with at least 10 valid rows.
